v34_tobarra_la_quad.finding: Adding LOFO-tobarra or LOFO-LA as 4th ensemble member raises holdout test IoU (~0.90) but is LEAKAGE: those LOFO folds train on Cardoso (= holdout test). Rejected for GO. Only members never trained on Cardoso may claim holdout GO.

notes_v34: Cached mix×threshold sweep + denser grid cannot beat v33 honestly; thr=0.4 overfits VAL. Loop upgraded: growth-cache mix, multi_if EMA/hyper rotation, freeze-protected members.
stop_reason: User requested close-out. Product clm_ensemble_v34 stable after 30+ rounds; 3-way loop plateaued (temps reaffirm champion; multi_if/multi_obj no GO).
